standard_prerequisites.name: The local description of an invertible module as a direct summand of a finite free module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 4540-4542) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Bounds the local shape of the modules that have to be parametrised.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a sheaf by glueing data relative to an open covering
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4550-4553) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the collection of locally described modules into a set of glueing data.

core_obligations: Local shape: the proof recalls that an invertible module is locally a direct summand of a finite free module, so on the members of a covering it is described by a direct summand of a finite free module of a prescribed rank (proof lines 4540-4547)

The parameters form sets: the isomorphism classes of the local pieces form a set because the module of homomorphisms between finite free modules is a set, and the glueing data together with the coverings indexed injectively by subsets of the space form a set (proof lines 4548-4556)
Conclusion: the invertible modules are therefore parametrised by a set, and choosing one representative in each isomorphism class gives the required set (proof lines 4556-4557)
proof_roadmap: 任何可逆模局部是有限自由模的直和项（本章引理），故在某个覆盖的每一块上是 O_U^{⊕r(j)} 的直和项。
这些局部同构类构成集合（Hom(O_U^{⊕r},O_U^{⊕r}) 是集合），粘接数据与以 X 子集为指标的覆盖也各成集合，故全体可逆模被一个集合参数化。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a set of invertible modules meeting every isomorphism class exactly once (author lemma at source lines 4531-4537, label lemma-pic-set). The proof (source lines 4539-4558) uses that an invertible module is locally a direct summand of a finite free module, parametrises the local pieces by direct summands of finite free modules over a covering, and observes that the isomorphism classes of those pieces, the glueing data and the coverings each form sets (proof lines 4540-4557). The parametrisation together with the set-theoretic bookkeeping is the content. H2.
